premise.claim: InPlaceOnly is not separately implemented and behaves identically to InPlaceIfPossible (both in-place update on an image-only change; both fall back to Pod recreation rather than fail on an in-place-incompatible change).
premise.evidence: Code: no `case InPlaceOnly`/strategy-specific branch exists; the two runtime branch points (stateful_instance_set_control.go:788, statelessmode/sync/update.go:182) use `Type != RecreatePod`, treating InPlaceOnly and InPlaceIfPossible identically; inPlaceUpdateInstance returns (false,nil) on CanUpdateInPlace=false -> caller recreates (no fail). The one divergence (ValidateInstanceSetUpdate, statelessmode/core/implement.go:162, guards on ==InPlaceIfPossible) has NO production caller (dead code). Live A/B on ACK cluster (installed v0.8.0-0c00546d, pre-enum v1alpha2 CRDs): Phase A image-only change -> both in-place (pod names unchanged, imageID changed); Phase B isolated containerPort change -> both fell back to recreation and converged Ready identically. See results/.

findings.title: ValidateInstanceSetUpdate diverges for InPlaceOnly but is dead code (no runtime effect)
findings.claim: ValidateInstanceSetUpdate (statelessmode/core/implement.go:162) runs its component-size-replace-patch guard only when Type==InPlaceIfPossible, so an InPlaceOnly set would skip it; this contradicts the deprecation note's 'behaves identically' if the guard were ever wired into a validating webhook.
findings.evidence: grep shows the method is declared in core/api.go:49, implemented in implement.go:162, stubbed in update_test.go:154, and has ZERO production call sites. No runtime effect today; the note's 'identical' claim holds at runtime. Not touched by this PR.
findings.proposedFix: Optional: either delete the dead ValidateInstanceSetUpdate, or change the guard to `Type == RecreatePod -> skip` so InPlaceOnly and InPlaceIfPossible are validated identically if it is ever wired in. Out of scope for a doc-only deprecation PR.

findings.title: rolling-update example removes the `router` role (scope creep beyond deprecation)
findings.claim: examples/basic/rbg/update-strategy/rolling-update.yaml deletes the entire `router` role (-24 lines) and flips `decode` from InPlaceOnly to RecreatePod. Removing a role is unrelated to deprecating InPlaceOnly.
findings.evidence: diff: the `decode` role switched InPlaceOnly->RecreatePod (in scope) but the `router` role was deleted entirely (out of scope).
findings.proposedFix: If the goal is only to stop demonstrating InPlaceOnly, switch `decode` to InPlaceIfPossible (the value the note steers users toward) and keep `router`. Or confirm the role removal is intentional.

backwardsCompat.evidence: Live: InPlaceOnly accepted by pre-enum v1alpha2 CRD and pods reconciled to Ready. Diff: the enum value InPlaceOnly is retained in all regenerated CRDs (rolebasedgroups, rolebasedgroupsets, roleinstancesets) and deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml; only the description text gains a deprecation note. existing CRs with InPlaceOnly are not rejected.

crdRegenConsistency.evidence: The 'Note: InPlaceOnly is deprecated; use InPlaceIfPossible.' description line was added to all 3 CRD bases and all 3 matching blocks in deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml; enum lists unchanged.
